label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User-controlled 'state' parameter flows into session attribute lookup key ('oauth_state_' + state), then retrieved value is used in response.sendRedirect(redirect). While redirect.startsWith('/') provides some constraint, it allows protocol-relative URLs (//evil.com) and relies on prior session population which may have been controlled by attackers during OAuth handshake. Resolved sink value at sendRedirect(redirect) depends on attacker-controlled state parameter via session attribute retrieval.

evidence.note: User-controlled 'state' parameter flows into session attribute key construction and subsequent redirect usage
